name: <name>
comment-versions: Mid-2026 tested set. Tina stack + next-auth v4 are load-bearing pins; Next is held at 15.x as the safe OpenNext baseline (the tina-self-hosted-demo tracks Next 16 — bump if your OpenNext version supports it). Run the Phase 8 build and bump anything that fails. react-dnd(+html5-backend) are Tina admin peers — keep them.
comment-db: Default --db upstash (works on Workers over HTTP). For --db mongodb the scaffolder swaps upstash-redis-level -> mongodb-level (^0.0.4) — but MongoDB is fragile on Workers; see references/deploy-cloudflare.md.
comment-opennext: @opennextjs/cloudflare is the current CF adapter (next-on-pages is deprecated). If install resolves an unexpected major, run `npm i @opennextjs/cloudflare@latest` and `npm i -D wrangler@latest`.
